# Public sample photographs

- `photos/ps5.jpg`: **PlayStation 5 and DualSense (2)**, Osh33m. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PlayStation_5_and_DualSense_(2).jpg), [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
- `photos/watch.jpg`: **Casio F-91W 5051**, Ashley Pomeroy. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Casio_F-91W_5051.jpg), [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/).

Downloaded originals are unchanged. The analysis pipeline rotates/resizes and re-encodes images in memory before sending them to Gemini. Photographs retain their respective Creative Commons licenses and are not covered by the package's software license. Neither author endorses this demo.

These are clear product photographs, not cluttered storage-box scenes. The duplicate test uses the same photograph twice, not independently photographed views. The two product scenes are analyzed separately.

- `photos/kanken.jpg`: **Fjallraven Kanken backpack (Unsplash)**, Mitchell Orr. [Source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fjallraven_Kanken_backpack_(Unsplash).jpg), [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Unchanged original.
